rationale: TWLO gapped down ~23% on disappointing Q4 guidance and is now trading at 81% of today's range near $200, having bounced significantly off the $180 low. The stock is pressing against the 9-EMA ($200.10) with the last few candles showing a stall and slight rollover, creating ambiguity — neither a clean continuation short (too far from the open gap, already bounced 11%) nor a convincing long (negative news catalyst, broad market weakness with SPY -1.35% and VIXY +7.62%).
